from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) taken from the drawing callouts and geometry
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
sleeve_outer_diameter = 38.4          # outer diameter of the cylindrical sleeve
sleeve_inner_diameter = 26.9          # bore diameter (derived from drawing scale)
flange_outer_diameter = 45.3          # outer diameter of the end flange
flange_inner_diameter = 26.9          # through bore in the flange (same as sleeve bore)
sleeve_length         = 58.7          # length of the sleeve portion
flange_length         = 21.3          # length of the flange portion
fillet_radius         = 2.1           # edge fillet on the free end of the sleeve
chamfer_size          = 2.0           # chamfer on the outer edge of the flange face

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part_builder:
    # 1. Sleeve body
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sleeve_sk:
        Circle(sleeve_outer_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=sleeve_length)

    # 2. Flange at the end of the sleeve
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(sleeve_length)) as flange_sk:
        Circle(flange_outer_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=flange_length)

    # 3. Central through bore
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as bore_sk:
        Circle(sleeve_inner_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=sleeve_length + flange_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 4. Fillet the two edges at the free end of the sleeve (2× R2.1)
    free_end_edges = part_builder.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY).sort_by(Axis.Z)[:2]
    fillet(free_end_edges, fillet_radius)

    # 5. Chamfer the outer edge of the flange face
    flange_face_edges = part_builder.edges().filter_by(Plane.XY).sort_by(Axis.Z)[-2:]
    outer_flange_edge = sorted(flange_face_edges,
                               key=lambda e: e.bounding_box().size.X)[-1]
    chamfer(outer_flange_edge, chamfer_size)

part = part_builder.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_width = 80.0          # overall width of the bracket

slot_depth = 4.6            # slot depth
slot_centers_z = [14.3, 25.7, 42.9, 54.3]   # slot center heights from bottom

fillet_radius = 6.9         # corner fillet radius

# --- Build the part ---
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Vertical leg: rectangle on XZ plane, extruded along -Y
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk_v:
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, plate_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(plate_width, plate_height)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk_h:
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, plate_depth / 2)):
            Rectangle(plate_width, plate_depth)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(0)) as sk_b:
        with Locations((boss_offset_x + boss_width / 2, plate_height / 2)):
            Rectangle(boss_width, boss_height)
    extrude(amount=-boss_thickness)

    for z in slot_centers_z:

                SlotOverall(slot_length, slot_width)

    right_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).filter_by_position(

# ---------------- Primary dimensions (mm) ----------------
plate_width      = 40.0    # back plate width
plate_height     = 76.4    # back plate height (overall envelope)
plate_thickness  = 0.9     # back plate thickness (DETAIL A)

frame_width      = 32.7    # frame outer width
frame_height     = 72.7    # frame outer height
frame_depth      = 18.2    # frame depth (depth of the closed rectangular ring)
frame_wall       = 7.3     # frame wall thickness (all four sides)

leg_size         = 7.3     # square leg cross-section
leg_length       = 40.0    # leg projection length

hole_diameter    = 3.6     # central through hole in the plate

# ---------------- Derived values ----------------
leg_offset_x     = plate_thickness + frame_depth      # front face of frame
leg_offset_y     = frame_width / 2 - leg_size / 2     # leg centre in width direction
leg_offset_z     = frame_height / 2 - leg_size / 2    # leg centre in height direction

# ---------------- Build ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # --- Back plate (thin flat plate, hole through its centre) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as plate_sk:
        Rectangle(plate_width, plate_height)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- Rectangular frame (closed ring) on the front face of the plate ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(plate_thickness)) as frame_sk:
        Rectangle(frame_width, frame_height)
        Rectangle(frame_width - 2 * frame_wall,
                  frame_height - 2 * frame_wall,
                  mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=frame_depth)

    # --- Four square legs projecting forward from the frame corners ---
    with Locations(
        (leg_offset_x,  leg_offset_y,  leg_offset_z),
        (leg_offset_x, -leg_offset_y,  leg_offset_z),
        (leg_offset_x,  leg_offset_y, -leg_offset_z),

        Box(leg_length, leg_size, leg_size,
            align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))

    # --- Central clearance hole through the back plate ---
    with Locations((plate_thickness / 2, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, plate_thickness * 4,
                 rotation=(0, 90, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

"""
ORION-1190 - flat plate with an X-shaped outline.

The part is a constant-thickness plate (10.7 thick) whose outline is formed
by two identical rectangular bars crossing at the centre at an angle so
that the overall envelope measures 80.0 wide by 62.6 high.  Each bar has a
square cross-section of 10.7 x 10.7 (the printed 10.7 thickness carries
through to the in-plane bar width, as confirmed by the isometric view).
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Printed dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_thickness = 10.7     # plate thickness (depth direction)
bar_width       = 10.7     # in-plane width of each bar (perpendicular to its axis)
overall_width   = 80.0     # overall horizontal extent of the X
overall_height  = 62.6     # overall vertical extent of the X

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derive the bar length and inclination from the overall envelope
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# A bar of length L and width w inclined at angle t has a bounding box of
#   width  = L*cos(t) + w*sin(t)
#   height = L*sin(t) + w*cos(t)
# Equating both to the printed overall dimensions gives two equations in
# L and t (solved here with a short Newton iteration).
W, H, w = overall_width, overall_height, bar_width

t = 0.63                                    # initial guess (radians)
for _ in range(100):                        # Newton iteration on the angle
    f  = W * math.sin(t) + w * math.cos(2 * t) - H * math.cos(t)
    df = W * math.cos(t) - 2 * w * math.sin(2 * t) + H * math.sin(t)
    t -= f / df

bar_length = (W - w * math.sin(t)) / math.cos(t)   # ~91.3

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):             # the X lies in the vertical plane
        with Locations((0, 0)):
            Rectangle(bar_length, bar_width, rotation=math.degrees(t))
            Rectangle(bar_length, bar_width, rotation=-math.degrees(t))
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)         # constant plate thickness (10.7)

part = bp.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_diameter        = 80.0    # main plate outer diameter

through_hole_count    = 8       # number of through holes
bolt_circle_diameter  = 43.6    # bolt circle diameter

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk_plate:

    extrude(amount=boss_height)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk_bottom:
        Circle(bottom_boss_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-bottom_boss_height)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(top_z)) as sk_central:
        Circle(central_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-central_hole_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 8x Ø10.9 through holes on Ø43.6 bolt circle
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(top_z)) as sk_holes:

            Circle(through_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-(top_z + bottom_boss_height), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    def edges_at(radius, z_pos):

                if e.geom_type == GeomType.CIRCLE
                and abs(e.arc_center.Z - z_pos) < 0.01
                and abs(e.radius - radius) < 0.01]

    chamfer(edges_at(plate_diameter / 2, plate_thickness), chamfer_size)
    chamfer(edges_at(plate_diameter / 2, 0.0), chamfer_size)

    chamfer(part.edges(), chamfer_size)

Flat annular ring with rounded inner and outer edges.

Dimensions taken from the drawing:
    - Outer diameter ......... 80 mm   (ø80)
    - Inner diameter ......... 64 mm   (ø64)
    - Axial thickness ........ 9.1 mm

    - Outer edge fillet ...... 1.1 mm  (2x R1.1)

import math
from build123d import (
    BuildPart,
    BuildSketch,
    BuildLine,
    Polyline,
    make_face,
    extrude,
    Cylinder,
    Locations,
    Mode,
    export_step,
)

circumradius = across_corners / 2.0

# pointed left/right vertices at x = +/-40 (matches the 40 dimension).
hex_points = [
    (
        circumradius * math.cos(math.radians(60.0 * i)),
        circumradius * math.sin(math.radians(60.0 * i)),
    )
    for i in range(6)
]

    # --- hexagonal plate (extruded along +Z by the 24 thickness) ---
    with BuildSketch() as hex_sketch:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(*hex_points, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- central through hole, drilled along the plate axis ---
    with Locations((0.0, 0.0, plate_thickness / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_diameter / 2.0, height=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

cavity_length       = 65.0                       # internal length of the horizontal leg
cavity_width        = width - 2 * wall           # 44.1  (internal width)
cavity_inner_radius = inner_radius - wall        # 11.0  (concentric inner corner)

with BuildPart() as p:

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline((0, 0),
                     (0, height),
                     (length, height),
                     (length, height - leg_thickness),
                     (leg_thickness, height - leg_thickness),
                     (leg_thickness, 0),
                     close=True)
        make_face()

                        if abs(v.X - leg_thickness) < 0.1
                        and abs(v.Y - (height - leg_thickness)) < 0.1]
        fillet(inner_vertex, inner_radius)

        # Fillet the convex outer corners with R4.6
        outer_vertices = [v for v in sk.vertices()
                          if v.X < 0.1
                          or v.X > length - 0.1
                          or v.Y < 0.1]
        fillet(outer_vertices, fillet_radius)

    extrude(amount=width)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk2:
        with BuildLine() as bl2:
            Polyline((wall, wall),
                     (wall, height - leg_thickness - wall),
                     (wall + cavity_length, height - leg_thickness - wall),
                     (wall + cavity_length, height - wall),
                     (wall, height - wall),
                     close=True)
        make_face()

        # Fillet the concave inner corner of the cavity with R11.0
        cav_inner_vertex = [v for v in sk2.vertices()
                            if abs(v.X - wall) < 0.1
                            and abs(v.Y - (height - leg_thickness - wall)) < 0.1]

    end_edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(

Link plate with side boss block, reconstructed from the drawing.

Dimensions taken from the print:
  plate: 80 long x 40 wide x 12 thick, holes 2x ⌀12 THRU (spotface ⌀17.9 x 0.3 deep),
         hole centers 28 / 52 from the bottom end (i.e. 24 apart, symmetric about mid-length),
         all plate edges filleted R1.9 (10x R1.9).
  boss:  40 wide (flush with plate width), 43.8 deep, bottom 12 above plate bottom,
         top 68 above plate bottom, top edge chamfered C28.0,
         lower front corner relieved by a step (12 high).
"""

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plate (link plate) dimensions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_length    = 80.0     # overall length of the link plate
plate_width     = 40.0     # overall width of the link plate
plate_thickness = 12.0     # plate thickness (through thickness of the link)

hole_diameter   = 12.0     # 2x ⌀12 THRU
hole_offset     = 28.0     # hole centre distance from the nearest plate end
hole_pitch      = 24.0     # derived: 80 - 2 * 28  (centres 28 and 52 from bottom)

spot_diameter   = 17.9     # spotface diameter
spot_depth      = 0.3      # spotface depth

plate_fillet    = 1.9      # 10x R1.9 edge fillets

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Boss block dimensions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
block_width     = 40.0     # boss width (flush with the plate width)
block_depth     = 43.8     # boss projection from the plate face
block_bottom    = 12.0     # boss bottom edge height above the plate bottom
block_top       = 68.0     # boss top edge height above the plate bottom
block_height    = block_top - block_bottom          # 56.0

step_height     = 12.0     # step relief height at the boss front bottom corner
step_depth      = 13.8     # step relief depth into the boss front face

chamfer_size    = 28.0     # C28.0 chamfer on the boss top edge

# Derived hole centre positions (measured from the bottom end of the plate)
hole_center_low  = hole_offset                       # 28.0
hole_center_high = plate_length - hole_offset        # 52.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- flat link plate (rectangular blank with square ends) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk_plate:
        with BuildLine() as ln_plate:
            Line((0.0, 0.0), (plate_width, 0.0))
            Line((plate_width, 0.0), (plate_width, plate_length))
            Line((plate_width, plate_length), (0.0, plate_length))
            Line((0.0, plate_length), (0.0, 0.0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # ---- round the two ends into full-radius lobes (R20 = plate_width / 2) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk_lobes:
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_low)):
            Circle(plate_width / 2)
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_high)):
            Circle(plate_width / 2)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.ADD)

    # ---- fillet the plate perimeter edges (the 10x R1.9 callout) ----
    plate_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
    fillet(plate_edges, radius=plate_fillet)

    # ---- 2x ⌀12 through holes ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk_holes:
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_low)):
            Circle(hole_diameter / 2)
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_high)):
            Circle(hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- spotface ⌀17.9 x 0.3 deep on the front face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(-plate_thickness)) as sk_spot:
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_low)):
            Circle(spot_diameter / 2)
        with Locations((plate_width / 2, hole_center_high)):
            Circle(spot_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=spot_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- boss block with C28.0 chamfered top edge ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(-plate_thickness)) as sk_boss:
        with BuildLine() as ln_boss:
            Line((0.0, block_bottom), (block_depth - chamfer_size, block_top))
            Line((block_depth - chamfer_size, block_top), (block_depth, block_top - chamfer_size))
            Line((block_depth, block_top - chamfer_size), (block_depth, block_bottom))
            Line((block_depth, block_bottom), (0.0, block_bottom))
            Line((0.0, block_bottom), (0.0, block_top))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=block_width, mode=Mode.ADD)

    # ---- step relief cut into the boss front face (bottom corner) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(-plate_thickness)) as sk_step:
        with BuildLine() as ln_step:
            Line((block_depth - step_depth, block_bottom),
                 (block_depth - step_depth, block_bottom + step_height))
            Line((block_depth - step_depth, block_bottom + step_height),
                 (block_depth, block_bottom + step_height))
            Line((block_depth, block_bottom + step_height),
                 (block_depth, block_bottom))
            Line((block_depth, block_bottom),
                 (block_depth - step_depth, block_bottom))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=block_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- small blend on the remaining sharp vertical edges ----
    blend_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y).filter_by(
        lambda e: e.length < block_depth + 1.0
    )
    fillet(blend_edges, radius=plate_fillet)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

outer_depth = 45.7          # Y dimension
outer_height = 80.0         # Z dimension

wall_thickness = 11.4

# Fillet radii (front face corners and outer edges)
fillet_radius_small = 1.1   # 3× R1.1 corners
fillet_radius_bottom = 2.3  # R2.3 corner / bottom edge
fillet_radius_top = 2.9     # R2.9 corner / top edge

# Derived inner cavity dimensions
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_depth = outer_depth - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_height = outer_height - 2 * wall_thickness

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the hollow box with an open front face
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_box = Box(outer_width, outer_depth, outer_height)
inner_box = Box(inner_width, inner_depth, inner_height)

# Shift the inner cavity toward the back so the front wall remains open
inner_box = inner_box.translate((0, wall_thickness, 0))

part = outer_box - inner_box

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet the four vertical edges on the front face
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
front_vertical_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(e.center().Y) < 0.1
]

for e in front_vertical_edges:
    cx = e.center().X
    cz = e.center().Z
    if cx < 0 and cz < 0:      # bottom-left  → R1.1
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_small)
    elif cx < 0 and cz > 0:    # top-left     → R1.1
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_small)
    elif cx > 0 and cz < 0:    # bottom-right → R2.3
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_bottom)
    elif cx > 0 and cz > 0:    # top-right    → R2.9
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_top)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet the four vertical edges on the back face (same radii)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
back_vertical_edges = [
    e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    if abs(e.center().Y - outer_depth) < 0.1
]

for e in back_vertical_edges:
    cx = e.center().X
    cz = e.center().Z
    if cx < 0 and cz < 0:
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_small)
    elif cx < 0 and cz > 0:
        part = fillet(e, fillet_radius_small)
    elif cx > 0 and cz < 0:

    elif cx > 0 and cz > 0:

    if abs(e.center().Y) < 0.1 and e.center().Z > 0

with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- Revolve a rectangular cross-section / extrude an annulus ---
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        Circle(outer_diameter / 2)
        Circle(inner_diameter / 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=height)

    # Helper: find circular edges lying at a given Z level
    def circular_edges_at(z_level):
        return [
            e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE)
            if isclose(e.center().Z, z_level, abs_tol=1e-3)
        ]

    # --- Fillet the top outer edge (R4.8) ---
    top_outer = [
        e for e in circular_edges_at(height)
        if isclose(e.radius, outer_diameter / 2, abs_tol=1e-3)
    ]
    fillet(top_outer, fillet_top_outer)

    # --- Fillet the bottom outer edge (R5.2) ---
    bottom_outer = [
        e for e in circular_edges_at(0.0)
        if isclose(e.radius, outer_diameter / 2, abs_tol=1e-3)
    ]
    fillet(bottom_outer, fillet_bottom_outer)

    # --- Fillet the top inner edge (R4) ---
    top_inner = [
        e for e in circular_edges_at(height)
        if isclose(e.radius, inner_diameter / 2, abs_tol=1e-3)
    ]

inner = Box(width - 2 * wall, depth - 2 * wall, height - 2 * wall)
inner = fillet(inner.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), inner_r)

    y = R0 * math.sin(angle) * sy
    outer_points.append((x, y))

    angle = math.radians(90 + 36 + i * 72)
    x = r0 * math.cos(angle) * sx
    y = r0 * math.sin(angle) * sy
    inner_points.append((x, y))

def edges_at_z(edges, z, tol=0.1):
    return [e for e in edges if abs(e.center().Z - z) < tol]

def edges_with_radius(edges, r, tol=0.1):
    return [e for e in edges if abs(e.radius - r) < tol]

    edges_at_z(circular_edges, main_length + shaft_length), shaft_diameter / 2
)

    edges_at_z(circular_edges, main_length), shaft_diameter / 2
)

hole_bottom_edges = edges_with_radius(
    edges_at_z(circular_edges, 0), hole_diameter / 2
)

"""
Part: SIGMA-5624  (draftwright)
Description: A flat plate with two circular end bosses (each carrying a
through hole), a tapered arm running out to a small cylindrical pin, and
a flat (30.2 A/F) machined across the top of the upper boss.
"""

from math import sqrt, asin, atan2, cos, sin, pi

from build123d import (
    BuildPart, BuildSketch, BuildLine, Plane, Locations,
    Circle, Rectangle, Polyline, make_face, extrude, Cylinder,
    Mode, Vector, export_step,
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from the drawing (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_thickness  = 7.7      # plate / web thickness
boss_radius      = 15.5     # outer radius of the end bosses (R15.5)
boss_height      = 10.0     # height of the raised bosses above the plate
hole_diameter    = 24.4     # through hole diameter (2x ⌀24.4 THRU)
hole_spacing     = 53.2     # distance between the two hole centres
edge_offset      = 15.5     # distance from the flat edge to the hole centreline
overall_length   = 80.0     # overall length of the part
pin_diameter     = 11.1     # diameter of the small end pin (⌀11.1)
hex_across_flats = 30.2     # flat width across the top of the upper boss
pin_height       = 36.0     # pin centre height above the upper hole centre

hole_radius = hole_diameter / 2.0
pin_radius  = pin_diameter / 2.0

upper_hole_center = (edge_offset, 0.0)
lower_hole_center = (edge_offset, -hole_spacing)
pin_center        = (overall_length - pin_radius, pin_height)

# Flat cut geometry (30.2 A/F across the top of the upper boss)
flat_half_width = hex_across_flats / 2.0
flat_height     = sqrt(boss_radius ** 2 - flat_half_width ** 2)   # 3.5 above centre
flat_cut_depth  = boss_height - flat_height                       # depth of cut

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:

    # --- flat plate body: two round ends joined by a straight web ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with Locations(upper_hole_center):
            Circle(boss_radius)
        with Locations(lower_hole_center):
            Circle(boss_radius)
        with Locations((edge_offset, -hole_spacing / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(2.0 * boss_radius, hole_spacing)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- tapered arm from the upper boss out to the pin ---
    c1 = Vector(upper_hole_center[0], upper_hole_center[1], 0.0)
    c2 = Vector(pin_center[0], pin_center[1], 0.0)
    d  = (c2 - c1).length
    phi   = atan2(c2.Y - c1.Y, c2.X - c1.X)
    alpha = asin((boss_radius - pin_radius) / d)

    def tangent_pair(sign: float):
        ang = phi + sign * (pi / 2.0 + alpha)
        return (c1 + boss_radius * Vector(cos(ang), sin(ang), 0.0),
                c2 + pin_radius  * Vector(cos(ang), sin(ang), 0.0))

    t1a, t2a = tangent_pair(+1.0)
    t1b, t2b = tangent_pair(-1.0)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(t1a, t2a, t2b, t1b, close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- small cylindrical pin at the end of the arm ---
    with Locations((pin_center[0], pin_center[1], 0.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=pin_radius, height=plate_thickness)

    # --- raised bosses at the two hole locations ---
    with Locations((upper_hole_center[0], upper_hole_center[1], plate_thickness)):
        Cylinder(radius=boss_radius, height=boss_height)
    with Locations((lower_hole_center[0], lower_hole_center[1], plate_thickness)):
        Cylinder(radius=boss_radius, height=boss_height)

    # --- machine the flat across the top of the upper boss (30.2 A/F) ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness + boss_height)):
        with Locations((edge_offset, boss_radius - flat_cut_depth / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(hex_across_flats, flat_cut_depth)
    extrude(amount=-flat_cut_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- drill the two through holes (2x ⌀24.4 THRU) ---
    with Locations((upper_hole_center[0], upper_hole_center[1], 0.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_radius,
                 height=plate_thickness + boss_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    with Locations((lower_hole_center[0], lower_hole_center[1], 0.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_radius,
                 height=plate_thickness + boss_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

export_step(part.part, "output.step")

"""
Flanged plate with central boss and hexagonal top.
Drawing: RAVEN-6327, sheet 1/1, scale 1:1, ISO 2768-m.

Key features (all dimensions in mm):
  - Flat base plate 80 x 37.1 x 7.0 with 4x R7.0 corner radii
  - Two 2x Dia 8.1 through holes located 10.7 in from each plate end
  - Central cylindrical boss Dia 37.1, 23.2 tall above the plate
  - Hexagonal top 23.2 A/F, 18.6 tall
  - Central through hole Dia 9.3
  - Counterbore Dia 19.7, 19.7 deep from the boss top face
  - Overall height plate + boss = 30.1 (7.0 + 23.2)
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ---------------- primary dimensions (mm) ----------------
plate_length       = 80.0     # overall length of the base plate (front view)
plate_width        = 37.1     # overall width of the base plate (plan view)
plate_thickness    = 7.0      # plate thickness (DETAIL A)
corner_radius      = 7.0      # 4x R7.0 corner radii

mount_hole_dia     = 8.1      # 2x Dia 8.1 THRU
mount_hole_offset  = 10.7     # distance from plate end to mounting hole centre
mount_hole_spacing = plate_length - 2.0 * mount_hole_offset   # 58.6

boss_dia           = 37.1     # central cylindrical boss diameter
boss_total_height  = 23.2     # boss height above the plate (30.1 - 7.0)
hex_height         = 18.6     # height of the hexagonal top section
hex_across_flats   = 23.2     # 23.2 A/F hex size

through_hole_dia   = 9.3      # central through hole
cbore_dia          = 19.7     # counterbore diameter
cbore_depth        = 19.7     # counterbore depth

boss_base_height   = boss_total_height - hex_height        # 4.6
hex_circumradius   = hex_across_flats / math.sqrt(3.0)     # 13.39
chamfer_size       = 2.0      # chamfer on the boss shoulder

# ---------------- build ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- base plate ----
    with BuildSketch() as plate_sketch:
        RectangleRounded(plate_length, plate_width, corner_radius)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # ---- cylindrical boss base ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)) as boss_sketch:
        Circle(boss_dia / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=boss_base_height)

    # ---- chamfer the shoulder where the boss meets the hex top ----
    shoulder = part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by_position(
        Axis.Z,
        plate_thickness + boss_base_height - 0.01,
        plate_thickness + boss_base_height + 0.01,
    )
    chamfer(shoulder, chamfer_size)

    # ---- hexagonal top ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness + boss_base_height)) as hex_sketch:
        RegularPolygon(hex_circumradius, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_height)

    # ---- central through hole ----
    with Locations((0, 0, -1.0)):
        Cylinder(through_hole_dia / 2.0,
                 plate_thickness + boss_total_height + 2.0,

inner_fillet = 5.0            # inner corner fillet radius (2× R5.0)

bottom_left_chamfer_angle = 30.0        # angle from the vertical edge (degrees)
bottom_left_chamfer_horizontal = bottom_left_chamfer_length * math.tan(
    math.radians(bottom_left_chamfer_angle)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- outer profile (C-shaped outline) --------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as outer_profile:
        with BuildLine() as outer_line:
            # top edge of the top leg
            l1 = Line((0, overall_height), (top_leg_length - corner_chamfer, overall_height))
            # top-right 45° chamfer
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (top_leg_length, overall_height - corner_chamfer))
            # right edge of the top leg (down to the inner corner)
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (top_leg_length, top_leg_thickness))
            # bottom edge of the top leg (back to the left side)
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, top_leg_thickness))
            # left edge of the part (down to the bottom-left chamfer start)

            # bottom-left sloped chamfer

            # bottom edge of the bottom leg
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (overall_width - corner_chamfer, 0))
            # bottom-right 45° chamfer
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (overall_width, corner_chamfer))
            # right edge of the web
            l9 = Line(l8 @ 1, (overall_width, overall_height))
            # top edge of the web (closes the profile)

boss_height         = 17.0      # overall height of the corner bosses

central_boss_height = 17.0      # overall height of the central boss

rim_width           = 6.0       # width of the raised outer rim
hub_diameter        = 24.0      # central raised hub diameter
rib_width           = 4.0       # radial rib width
rib_count           = 6         # number of radial ribs

counterbore_dia     = 15.9      # counterbore diameter
counterbore_depth   = 5.0       # counterbore depth

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bottom_edges = [e for e in part.edges() if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6]
part = fillet(bottom_edges, edge_fillet)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

                Cylinder(boss_diameter / 2.0, boss_height - plate_thickness)

        Cylinder(central_boss_dia / 2.0, central_boss_height - plate_thickness)

cross_hole_depth = 47.7          # transverse hole drill depth
hole_offset = 18.7               # hole centre distance from the end faces
hex_across_flats = 15.2          # hex socket size across flats
hex_depth = 11.1                 # hex socket depth

with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- main cylindrical body ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        Circle(outer_radius)
    extrude(amount=height)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(height)) as slot_sk:

            Rectangle(slot_width, outer_radius + 1.0 - slot_radius)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as cbore_sk:

    for z in (hole_offset, height - hole_offset):

from build123d import *
import math

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) – taken from the drawing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter      = 80.0      # overall diameter across the blade tips
base_plate_diameter = 79.0      # diameter of the bottom base plate
overall_height      = 39.5      # total height of the part
base_plate_thickness= 5.3       # height of the solid base plate
blade_height        = 34.2      # height of the blade section
bore_diameter       = 14.5      # central through bore
hub_diameter        = 30.0      # diameter of the central hub
blade_thickness     = 2.6       # thickness of each blade plate
num_blades          = 10        # number of blades
fillet_radius       = 2.6       # fillet radius at the blade roots
blade_curvature_r   = 25.0      # radius of the curved blade centre line
blade_tangent_angle = 30.0      # angle of blade centre line at the root (degrees)

outer_radius        = outer_diameter / 2.0
base_plate_radius   = base_plate_diameter / 2.0
bore_radius         = bore_diameter / 2.0
hub_radius          = hub_diameter / 2.0
slot_depth          = blade_height          # depth of the slot cut

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base plate – the solid bottom disc
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
base_plate = Cylinder(base_plate_radius, base_plate_thickness)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Blade body – the solid cylinder from which the blades are cut
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
blade_body = Pos(0, 0, base_plate_thickness + blade_height / 2.0) * Cylinder(outer_radius, blade_height)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central through bore
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
bore = Pos(0, 0, overall_height / 2.0) * Cylinder(bore_radius, overall_height)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the slot profile – the cut that forms one gap between blades
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
tangent_rad = math.radians(blade_tangent_angle)

# centre of curvature of the blade centre line
cx = hub_radius - blade_curvature_r * math.cos(tangent_rad)
cy = blade_curvature_r * math.sin(tangent_rad)

# start angle of the centre line on the curvature circle
start_angle = math.atan2(-cy, hub_radius - cx)

# end angle where the centre line reaches the outer radius
C_mag_sq = cx**2 + cy**2
rhs = (outer_radius**2 - C_mag_sq - blade_curvature_r**2) / (2.0 * blade_curvature_r)
A = cx
B = cy
amplitude = math.sqrt(A**2 + B**2)
phase = math.atan2(B, A)
cos_val = rhs / amplitude
delta = math.acos(cos_val)
psi1 = phase + delta
psi2 = phase - delta
end_angle = psi1 if psi1 > start_angle else psi2

# start / end points of the centre line
start_pt = (hub_radius, 0.0)
start_tangent = (math.cos(tangent_rad + math.pi / 2.0), math.sin(tangent_rad + math.pi / 2.0))
inner_start = (start_pt[0] - start_tangent[0] * (blade_thickness / 2.0),
               start_pt[1] - start_tangent[1] * (blade_thickness / 2.0))
outer_start = (start_pt[0] + start_tangent[0] * (blade_thickness / 2.0),
               start_pt[1] + start_tangent[1] * (blade_thickness / 2.0))

end_pt = (cx + blade_curvature_r * math.cos(end_angle),
          cy + blade_curvature_r * math.sin(end_angle))
end_tangent = (-math.sin(end_angle), math.cos(end_angle))
inner_end = (end_pt[0] - end_tangent[0] * (blade_thickness / 2.0),
             end_pt[1] - end_tangent[1] * (blade_thickness / 2.0))
outer_end = (end_pt[0] + end_tangent[0] * (blade_thickness / 2.0),
             end_pt[1] + end_tangent[1] * (blade_thickness / 2.0))

with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as slot_sk:
    with BuildLine() as bl:
        CenterArc((cx, cy), blade_curvature_r - blade_thickness / 2.0,
                  start_angle, end_angle - start_angle)
        Line(inner_end, outer_end)
        CenterArc((cx, cy), blade_curvature_r + blade_thickness / 2.0,

from build123d import *

# ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
arm_width         = 40.0     # "40"      width of each arm
overall_size      = 80.0     # "80"      overall span of the cross
plate_thickness   = 20.0     # "20"      plate thickness
inner_fillet_r    = 5.0      # "4x R5"   internal (concave) corner fillets
tip_corner_r      = 10.0     # corner radius at the arm tips (undimensioned)
chamfer_size      = 5.0      # "20x C5"  chamfers on the top face edges
hole_diameter     = 12.1     # "⌀12.1"   central hole diameter
hole_depth        = 8.0      # "↧ 8"     hole depth from the top face

half_arm     = arm_width / 2.0
half_overall = overall_size / 2.0

with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---------- flat cross-shaped outline ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Polyline(
                ( half_arm, -half_overall),
                ( half_arm, -half_arm),
                ( half_overall, -half_arm),
                ( half_overall,  half_arm),
                ( half_arm,  half_arm),
                ( half_arm,  half_overall),
                (-half_arm,  half_overall),
                (-half_arm,  half_arm),
                (-half_overall,  half_arm),
                (-half_overall, -half_arm),
                (-half_arm, -half_arm),
                (-half_arm, -half_overall),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()

        # 4x R5 internal (concave) corner fillets
        inner_verts = [
            v for v in base_sk.vertices()
            if abs(abs(v.X) - half_arm) < 1e-6 and abs(abs(v.Y) - half_arm) < 1e-6
        ]
        fillet(inner_verts, radius=inner_fillet_r)

        # 8x convex corner rounds at the four arm tips
        tip_verts = [
            v for v in base_sk.vertices()
            if (abs(abs(v.X) - half_arm) < 1e-6 and abs(abs(v.Y) - half_overall) < 1e-6)
            or (abs(abs(v.X) - half_overall) < 1e-6 and abs(abs(v.Y) - half_arm) < 1e-6)
        ]
        fillet(tip_verts, radius=tip_corner_r)

    # ---------- extrude the plate ----------
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # ---------- 20x C5 chamfer on the top perimeter edges ----------
    # (the 4 internal fillet edges are left sharp, giving exactly 20 chamfered edges)
    top_face = part.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    chamfer_edges = []
    for e in top_face.edges():
        p = e @ 0.5                                  # midpoint of the edge
        d = (((abs(p.X) - (half_arm + inner_fillet_r)) ** 2
              + (abs(p.Y) - (half_arm + inner_fillet_r)) ** 2) ** 0.5)
        if d > inner_fillet_r + 1.0:                 # skip the internal fillet arcs
            chamfer_edges.append(e)
    chamfer(chamfer_edges, length=chamfer_size)

    # ---------- central blind hole: ⌀12.1 x 8 deep from the top face ----------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thickness - hole_depth / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(radius=hole_diameter / 2.0, height=hole_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

around two through holes.

from build123d import *
from math import cos, radians

# ---------------- Primary dimensions (mm) ----------------
plate_width = 80.0          # overall plate width  (X)
plate_height = 69.2         # overall plate height (Y)
plate_thickness = 3.0       # flat plate thickness

# Raised rim on the back face

rim_height = 2.0            # rim depth

# Central boss on the back face
boss_width = 30.0
boss_height = 52.0
boss_depth = 11.0           # plate (3) + boss (11) = 14.0 overall depth
boss_offset_x = -8.3        # boss centre offset from plate centre

# Through holes
hole_diameter = 5.5         # 2x ⌀5.5 THRU
hole_spacing = 20.7         # centre-to-centre distance of the two holes
hole_offset_x = 23.2 - plate_width / 2   # 23.2 from the left edge

# Hexagonal bosses on the front face
hex_flat_to_flat = 12.0
hex_circumradius = hex_flat_to_flat / (2 * cos(radians(30)))
hex_height = 2.0

# L-shaped corner ribs on the front face
rib_leg_length = 10.0
rib_leg_width = 2.0
rib_height = 2.0

# Edge chamfer
chamfer_size = 1.4          # 4x C1.4

# ---------------- Build ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:

    # ---- Main plate ----
    Box(plate_width, plate_height, plate_thickness)

    # ---- Raised rim on the back face ----
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thickness / 2)):
        Box(plate_width, plate_height, rim_height)
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thickness / 2)):
        Box(plate_width - 2 * rim_width,
            plate_height - 2 * rim_width,
            rim_height,
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Central boss on the back face ----
    with Locations((boss_offset_x, 0, plate_thickness / 2)):
        Box(boss_width, boss_height, boss_depth)

    # ---- Hexagonal bosses on the front face ----
    for y in (-hole_spacing / 2, hole_spacing / 2):
        with Locations((hole_offset_x, y, -plate_thickness / 2)):
            with BuildSketch() as hex_sk:
                RegularPolygon(hex_circumradius, 6)
            extrude(amount=-hex_height)

    # ---- L-shaped corner ribs on the front face ----
    inner_w = plate_width / 2 - rim_width
    inner_h = plate_height / 2 - rim_width
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        for sy in (-1, 1):
            cx = sx * (inner_w - rib_leg_length / 2)
            cy = sy * (inner_h - rib_leg_length / 2)
            with Locations((cx, cy, -plate_thickness / 2)):
                with BuildSketch() as rib_sk:
                    with Locations((sx * (rib_leg_length - rib_leg_width) / 2,
                                    sy * (rib_leg_length - rib_leg_width) / 2)):
                        Rectangle(rib_leg_length, rib_leg_width)
                    with Locations((sx * (rib_leg_length - rib_leg_width) / 2,
                                    sy * (rib_leg_length - rib_leg_width) / 2)):
                        Rectangle(rib_leg_width, rib_leg_length)
                extrude(amount=-rib_height)

    # ---- Two ⌀5.5 through holes ----
    for y in (-hole_spacing / 2, hole_spacing / 2):

            Hole(hole_diameter / 2)

    # ---- Fillet the four vertical edges of the central boss ----
    boss_edges = [
        e for e in part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
        if abs(abs(e.center().X - boss_offset_x) - boss_width / 2) < 0.1
        and abs(abs(e.center().Y) - boss_height / 2) < 0.1

    if boss_edges:

        if abs(abs(e.center().X) - plate_width / 2) < 0.1

"""
Ring with radial teeth (spline coupling / toothed collar)
--------------------------------------------------------
Reconstructed from the multi-view drawing:
  * Front view  : circular ring, outer dia 80.0, through bore dia 68.4
  * Top view    : thin ring, 15.4 thick, spline teeth around the rim
  * Section A-A : radial tooth profile, 12 teeth, 2x R1.0 bore fillets,
                  12x R1.0 tooth-root fillets
  * Detail A    : tooth profile at 10:1, 35.0 root radius, 36.4 overall
                  tooth length (radial), tooth height 5.0
"""

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions taken directly from the drawing (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter   = 80.0        # outside diameter of the ring
inner_diameter   = 68.4        # through bore diameter
thickness        = 15.4        # axial length of the ring
tooth_count      = 12          # number of radial teeth (12x R1.0 callout)
tooth_height     = 5.0         # radial height of each tooth (40.0 - 35.0)
tooth_root_dia   = 70.0        # diameter at the root of the teeth (2 x 35.0)
tooth_base_width = 3.64        # tangential width of tooth at the root
tooth_tip_width  = 2.00        # tangential width of tooth at the tip
fillet_radius    = 1.0         # fillet radius (2x on bore, 12x on teeth)

# Derived radii
outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
root_radius  = tooth_root_dia / 2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Base ring (solid cylinder with a through bore)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as ring_bp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        Circle(outer_radius)
        Circle(inner_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=thickness)

ring = ring_bp.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Cut the radial teeth around the outer perimeter
#    Each tooth space is a trapezoidal slot cut through the full
#    thickness of the ring.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
for i in range(tooth_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / tooth_count

    with BuildPart() as slot_bp:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as slot_sk:
            with BuildLine() as bl:
                Polyline(
                    (-tooth_base_width / 2.0, root_radius),
                    ( tooth_base_width / 2.0, root_radius),
                    ( tooth_tip_width  / 2.0, outer_radius),
                    (-tooth_tip_width  / 2.0, outer_radius),
                    close=True,
                )
            make_face()
        extrude(amount=thickness)

    slot = slot_bp.part.rotate(Axis.Z, angle)
    ring = ring - slot

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fillet the two edges of the through bore (2x R1.0)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bore_edges = ring.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.radius - inner_radius) < 0.1
)
ring = ring.fillet(bore_edges, fillet_radius)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Fillet the vertical edges of the teeth (12x R1.0)
#    These are the straight edges running through the thickness
#    of the ring at the tooth roots and tips.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
tooth_edges = ring.edges().filter_by(GeomType.LINE).filter_by(
    lambda e: abs(e.length - thickness) < 0.1
)
ring = ring.fillet(tooth_edges, fillet_radius)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Export the finished part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(ring, "output.step")

web_radius          = web_diameter / 2.0
blade_length        = outer_radius - web_radius
countersink_depth   = (countersink_diameter - hole_diameter) / 2.0

# Build one twisted blade
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

for i in range(num_sections + 1):
    t = i / num_sections
    angle = t * twist_angle
    z = -length / 2.0 + t * length
    sec = Rectangle(blade_length, blade_thickness)
    sec = Rot(0, 0, angle) * sec
    sec = Pos(web_radius + blade_length / 2.0, 0, z) * sec
    sections.append(sec)

for r in range(num_slot_rows):
    for c in range(num_slot_cols):
        z_center = -length / 2.0 + (r + 0.5) * length / num_slot_rows
        t = (z_center + length / 2.0) / length
        angle = t * twist_angle
        x_center = -blade_length / 2.0 + (c + 0.5) * blade_length / num_slot_cols
        slot = Box(slot_width, blade_thickness * 3.0, slot_length)
        slot = Pos(web_radius + blade_length / 2.0 + x_center, 0, z_center) * slot
        slot = Rot(0, 0, angle) * slot
        twisted_blade = twisted_blade - slot

            outer_pts = [

                (-half_width, 0),                                   # left (long)
                (-half_width * math.cos(math.radians(30)), half_length * math.sin(math.radians(30))),  # top-left (short)

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions taken from the drawing (all in millimetres)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
block_size     = 80.0    # overall cube edge length (80.0 x 80.0 x 80.0)
edge_chamfer   = 8.0     # 12x C8.0 chamfer applied to every cube edge
through_dia    = 28.0    # central through hole diameter (⌀28.0 THRU)
cbore_dia      = 40.0    # counterbore diameter (⌀40.0)
cbore_depth    = 10.0    # counterbore depth per face (⌀40.0 ↧ 10)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Base solid – a cube with all twelve edges chamfered
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part = Box(block_size, block_size, block_size)
part = part.edges().chamfer(edge_chamfer)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Central through hole drilled along each of the three axes
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
part -= Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(through_dia / 2, block_size + 2)   # X axis
part -= Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(through_dia / 2, block_size + 2)   # Y axis
part -= Cylinder(through_dia / 2, block_size + 2)                   # Z axis

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ⌀40 counterbore, 10 deep, machined into each of the six faces
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
half = block_size / 2
face_axes = [
    (0,  1), (0, -1),   # +X and -X faces
    (1,  1), (1, -1),   # +Y and -Y faces
    (2,  1), (2, -1),   # +Z and -Z faces
]

for axis, sign in face_axes:
    if axis == 0:                       # faces normal to X
        rot = Rot(0, 90, 0)
        pos = Pos(sign * (half - cbore_depth / 2), 0, 0)
    elif axis == 1:                     # faces normal to Y
        rot = Rot(90, 0, 0)
        pos = Pos(0, sign * (half - cbore_depth / 2), 0)
    else:                               # faces normal to Z
        rot = Rot(0, 0, 0)
        pos = Pos(0, 0, sign * (half - cbore_depth / 2))

    part -= pos * rot * Cylinder(cbore_dia / 2, cbore_depth)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

plate_width = 51.3
plate_thickness = 6.7
boss_diameter = 25.3
boss_height = 4.0

mounting_hole_offset = 11.3  # Derived from 40.0 - 28.7

rib_thickness = 6.7
rib_height = 18.7

# --- Create the main part ---
with BuildPart() as p:
    # 1. Main rectangular plate
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk_plate:
        Rectangle(plate_length, plate_width)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # 2. Central boss
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)) as sk_boss:
        Circle(boss_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=boss_height)

    # 3. Central through hole
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness + boss_height)) as sk_central_hole:
        Circle(central_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness + boss_height + 1, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 4. Two mounting through holes
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)) as sk_mount_holes:
        with Locations((-mounting_hole_offset, 0), (mounting_hole_offset, 0)):
            Circle(mounting_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness + 1, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 5. Two side ears (cylindrical bosses)
    ear_offset_y = plate_width / 2 + ear_thickness / 2
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)) as sk_ears:
        with Locations(
            (ear_hole_spacing / 2, ear_offset_y),
            (-ear_hole_spacing / 2, ear_offset_y),
            (ear_hole_spacing / 2, -ear_offset_y),
            (-ear_hole_spacing / 2, -ear_offset_y)
        ):
            Circle(ear_radius)
    extrude(amount=ear_thickness)

    # 6. Ear through holes
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness + ear_thickness)) as sk_ear_holes:
        with Locations(
            (ear_hole_spacing / 2, ear_offset_y),
            (-ear_hole_spacing / 2, ear_offset_y),
            (ear_hole_spacing / 2, -ear_offset_y),
            (-ear_hole_spacing / 2, -ear_offset_y)
        ):
            Circle(ear_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=ear_thickness + 1, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 7. Angled flange at the bottom edge
    # The flange is created as a profile on the YZ plane and extruded across the plate width.
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(-plate_width / 2)) as sk_flange:
        with BuildLine() as bl_flange:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (0, -plate_thickness))
            l2 = Line((0, -plate_thickness), (flange_height, -plate_thickness - flange_length * math.sin(math.radians(flange_angle))))
            l3 = Line((flange_height, -plate_thickness - flange_length * math.sin(math.radians(flange_angle))), (flange_height, -plate_thickness - flange_length * math.sin(math.radians(flange_angle)) - plate_thickness))
            l4 = Line((flange_height, -plate_thickness - flange_length * math.sin(math.radians(flange_angle)) - plate_thickness), (0, -plate_thickness - plate_thickness))
            l5 = Line((0, -plate_thickness - plate_thickness), (0, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_width)

    # 8. Central reinforcing rib
    # The rib is created as a profile on the XZ plane and extruded across the plate thickness.
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(-plate_thickness / 2)) as sk_rib:
        with BuildLine() as bl_rib:
            l1 = Line((-rib_thickness / 2, 0), (rib_thickness / 2, 0))
            l2 = Line((rib_thickness / 2, 0), (rib_thickness / 2, -rib_height))
            l3 = Line((rib_thickness / 2, -rib_height), (-rib_thickness / 2, -rib_height))
            l4 = Line((-rib_thickness / 2, -rib_height), (-rib_thickness / 2, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # 9. Apply fillets
    # Fillet the vertical edges of the main plate and ears
    vertical_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    
    # Filter edges on the main plate perimeter
    plate_edges = vertical_edges.filter_by_position(Axis.X, -plate_length/2, plate_length/2)
    plate_edges = plate_edges.filter_by_position(Axis.Y, -plate_width/2, plate_width/2)
    fillet(plate_edges, radius=1.8)
    
    # Fillet the outer edges of the ears
    ear_edges = vertical_edges.filter_by_position(Axis.X, -plate_length/2, plate_length/2)
    ear_edges = ear_edges.filter_by_position(Axis.Y, -plate_width/2 - ear_thickness, plate_width/2 + ear_thickness)
    fillet(ear_edges, radius=ear_radius)

    # Fillet the top edges of the main plate around the boss
    top_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    top_edges = top_face.edges()
    fillet(top_edges, radius=0.9)

# Export the final part
export_step(p.part, "output.step")

"""
Flanged base with a central boss and a hexagonal drive head.

Geometry reconstructed from the drawing:
  - Base flange:   Ø80.0 diameter, 4.6 thick
  - Central boss:  Ø40.0 diameter, 8.8 tall above the flange
  - Hex drive head: 8.0 across-flats, 9.34 tall above the boss
  - Central through hole: Ø4.0 (scaled from the drawing)
  - Bolt holes: 8x Ø8.0 through holes on a Ø64.0 bolt circle
  - Edge fillets: R0.5 on 22 edges (8 top + 8 bottom of the bolt holes
                  and the 6 top edges of the hex head)
"""

import math
from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Key dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
flange_diameter      = 80.0     # outer diameter of the base flange
flange_thickness     = 4.6      # thickness of the base flange
boss_diameter        = 40.0     # diameter of the central raised boss
boss_height          = 8.8      # height of the boss above the flange
hex_across_flats     = 8.0      # across-flats size of the hex head
hex_height           = 9.34     # height of the hex head above the boss
through_hole_diameter = 4.0     # central through hole (scaled)
bolt_circle_diameter = 64.0     # diameter of the bolt hole circle
bolt_hole_diameter   = 8.0      # diameter of each bolt hole
bolt_hole_count      = 8        # number of bolt holes
fillet_radius        = 0.5      # edge fillet radius

# Derived values
hex_circumradius = (hex_across_flats / 2.0) / math.cos(math.pi / 6.0)
total_height     = flange_thickness + boss_height + hex_height

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Base flange (cylindrical plate)
    with BuildSketch() as flange_sk:
        Circle(flange_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=flange_thickness)

    # Central cylindrical boss on top of the flange
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(flange_thickness)) as boss_sk:
        Circle(boss_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=boss_height)

    # Hexagonal drive head on top of the boss
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(flange_thickness + boss_height)) as hex_sk:
        RegularPolygon(radius=hex_circumradius, side_count=6, rotation=30.0)
    extrude(amount=hex_height)

    # Central through hole (through the entire part)
    with BuildSketch() as hole_sk:
        Circle(through_hole_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=total_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Eight through holes equally spaced on the bolt circle
    with PolarLocations(bolt_circle_diameter / 2.0, bolt_hole_count):
        with BuildSketch() as bolt_sk:
            Circle(bolt_hole_diameter / 2.0)
        extrude(amount=flange_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Fillet 22 edges: 8 top + 8 bottom edges of the bolt holes
    # and the 6 top edges of the hexagonal head
    bolt_top_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z - flange_thickness) < 0.01
        and abs(e.radius - bolt_hole_diameter / 2.0) < 0.01
    ]
    bolt_bottom_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z) < 0.01
        and abs(e.radius - bolt_hole_diameter / 2.0) < 0.01
    ]
    hex_top_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z - total_height) < 0.01
    ]
    fillet(bolt_top_edges + bolt_bottom_edges + hex_top_edges, radius=fillet_radius)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(p.part, "output.step")

inner_web_radius = web_radius + rim_width

    with BuildSketch() as sk:

from build123d import *

# ---------------- DIMENSIONS (mm) ----------------
outer_size      = 80.0    # overall cube size (80 x 80 x 80)
wall_thickness  = 5.7     # uniform shell wall thickness
fillet_radius   = 5.7     # outer edge fillet radius (8x R5.7)
slot_leg_width  = 5.7     # U-slot leg width
slot_base_height= 5.7     # U-slot base height
slot_leg_length = 33.0    # U-slot leg length (undimensioned, scaled from view)
slot_leg_fillet = 2.85    # U-slot leg top fillet radius (half of leg width)
notch_width     = 5.7     # top edge notch width
notch_depth     = 5.7     # top edge notch depth

half = outer_size / 2.0

# ---------------- BUILD ----------------
with BuildPart() as part:

    # 1. Solid cube blank
    Box(outer_size, outer_size, outer_size)

    # 2. Fillet the four vertical corner edges (R5.7)
    fillet(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), radius=fillet_radius)

    # 3. Fillet the four top perimeter edges (R5.7) -> gives the 8x R5.7 set
    top_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    fillet(top_face.edges(), radius=fillet_radius)

    # 4. Shell the box, opening the top -> uniform 5.7 wall thickness (tray with closed bottom)
    shell(top_face, amount=-wall_thickness)

    # 5. U-shaped through-slot in the front wall
    #    Plane of the front face (normal = +Y, local X = global X, local Y = global Z)
    front_plane = Plane(origin=(0, -half, 0), x_dir=(1, 0, 0), z_dir=(0, 1, 0))

    with BuildSketch(front_plane) as slot_sk:
        with BuildLine() as slot_bl:
            pts = [
                (-half + wall_thickness,      -half),                            # outer bottom-left
                ( half - wall_thickness,      -half),                            # outer bottom-right
                ( half - wall_thickness,      -half + slot_leg_length),          # outer top-right
                ( half - 2 * wall_thickness,  -half + slot_leg_length),          # inner top-right
                ( half - 2 * wall_thickness,  -half + slot_base_height),         # inner base-right
                (-half + 2 * wall_thickness,  -half + slot_base_height),         # inner base-left
                (-half + 2 * wall_thickness,  -half + slot_leg_length),          # inner top-left
                (-half + wall_thickness,      -half + slot_leg_length),          # outer top-left
            ]
            Polyline(*pts, close=True)
        make_face()
        # Round the two leg tips (R2.85 = half of the 5.7 leg width)
        leg_top_verts = [v for v in slot_sk.vertices()
                         if abs(v.Z - (-half + slot_leg_length)) < 0.1]
        fillet(leg_top_verts, radius=slot_leg_fillet)

    extrude(amount=wall_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 6. Small rectangular notch in the top edge of the front wall (5.7 x 5.7, centered)
    with BuildSketch(front_plane) as notch_sk:
        with Locations((0, half - notch_depth / 2.0)):
            Rectangle(notch_width, notch_depth)
    extrude(amount=wall_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ---------------- EXPORT ----------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")

# ---- Key dimensions (mm) ----
outer_diameter = 80.0       # overall diameter across the lobe tips (Ø80.0)
root_diameter = 53.0        # diameter at the bottom of the grooves (Ø53.0)
height = 23.6               # overall height of the part
num_grooves = 13            # number of scallop grooves around the perimeter (13x)
chamfer_size = 2.9          # C2.9 chamfer on the top and bottom edges (13x C2.9)
bore_diameter = 12.0        # central through bore (from the top view)

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
root_radius = root_diameter / 2.0

# Scallop groove geometry: a circular cut whose deepest point reaches the root radius
groove_radius = 7.2
groove_center_radius = root_radius + groove_radius   # 33.7 -> groove bottom at 26.5

with BuildPart() as part:
    # Extrude the scalloped (fluted) profile
    with BuildSketch() as profile:
        Circle(outer_radius)
        with PolarLocations(groove_center_radius, num_grooves):
            Circle(groove_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=height)

    # C2.9 chamfers on the top and bottom outer edges (applied to the full scalloped rim)
    def outer_edge(face):
        return max(face.edges(), key=lambda e: e.bounding_box().size.X)

    top_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    bottom_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    chamfer([outer_edge(top_face)], length=chamfer_size)
    chamfer([outer_edge(bottom_face)], length=chamfer_size)

    # Central through bore
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(bore_diameter / 2.0, height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
import math

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Overall envelope
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_height = 80.0          # total height of the part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base plate (rectangular tab with through hole)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
plate_width   = 11.2           # plate width  (X direction)
plate_length  = 19.4           # plate length (Y direction)
plate_thick   = 3.7            # plate thickness (Z direction)
plate_hole_dia = 7.7           # through hole diameter
plate_hole_off = 0.9           # hole center offset from plate center (along Y)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main cylindrical body
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
body_dia      = 20.5           # body diameter
body_length   = 71.2           # body length (from top of plate to bottom of neck)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Threaded section on the body
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
thread_start  = 28.9           # distance from bottom of body to start of thread
thread_end    = 58.9           # distance from bottom of body to end of thread
thread_length = thread_end - thread_start   # 30.0 mm
thread_pitch  = 1.0            # thread pitch
thread_depth  = 0.7            # thread groove depth (radial)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reduced-diameter neck between body and head
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
neck_dia      = 11.5           # neck diameter
neck_length   = 2.8            # neck length

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Head (stepped cylindrical cap with central recess)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
head_dia        = 20.5         # head outer diameter (top face)
head_step_dia   = 15.4         # intermediate step diameter
head_groove_dia = 12.8         # groove diameter on head
head_hole_dia   = 5.9          # central recess diameter

head_base_h     = 0.7          # lower head land height
head_groove_h   = 0.8          # head groove height
head_step_h     = 0.4          # upper head step height
head_top_h      = 0.4          # top face height

recess_depth    = 2.8          # depth of central recess from top face
chamfer_size    = 0.5          # top edge chamfer

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- base plate ---------------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as base_sk:
        Rectangle(plate_width, plate_length)
    extrude(amount=plate_thick)

    # ---- through hole in plate ----------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, plate_hole_off, 0)):
        Hole(plate_hole_dia / 2)

    # ---- main body ----------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick)):
        Cylinder(body_dia / 2, body_length)

    # ---- thread grooves (cut into the body surface) -------------------------
    num_threads = int(thread_length / thread_pitch)
    for i in range(num_threads):
        z_pos = plate_thick + thread_start + i * thread_pitch
        with Locations((0, 0, z_pos)):
            with BuildSketch() as thread_sk:
                Circle(body_dia / 2 + thread_depth)
            extrude(amount=thread_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- neck ---------------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick + body_length)):
        Cylinder(neck_dia / 2, neck_length)

    # ---- head base ----------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick + body_length + neck_length)):
        Cylinder(head_dia / 2, head_base_h)

    # ---- head groove --------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick + body_length + neck_length + head_base_h)):
        Cylinder(head_groove_dia / 2, head_groove_h)

    # ---- head step ----------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick + body_length + neck_length
                    + head_base_h + head_groove_h)):
        Cylinder(head_step_dia / 2, head_step_h)

    # ---- head top face ------------------------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, plate_thick + body_length + neck_length
                    + head_base_h + head_groove_h + head_step_h)):
        Cylinder(head_dia / 2, head_top_h)

    # ---- central recess (blind hole in top face) ----------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, overall_height - recess_depth)):
        Cylinder(head_hole_dia / 2, recess_depth,
                 align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))

    # ---- top edge chamfer ---------------------------------------------------
    top_edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(GeomType.CIRCLE).sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:]
    chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(p.part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) taken from the drawing
# ------------------------------------------------------------
base_diameter      = 80.0        # overall diameter of the scalloped base
base_height        = 31.7        # height of the lower base section
total_height       = 68.1        # overall height of the part
top_height         = total_height - base_height   # height of the upper section
top_across_flats   = 66.7        # across-flats size of the upper hexagonal body
socket_across_flats = 50.3       # across-flats size of the internal hex socket
chamfer_size       = 2.6         # 12x C2.6 chamfer on the bottom edge of the base
notch_radius       = 6.65        # radius of the semicircular notches forming the scallops
num_notches        = 12          # number of scallops around the base

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
base_radius       = base_diameter / 2.0
top_circumradius  = top_across_flats / math.sqrt(3.0)
socket_circumradius = socket_across_flats / math.sqrt(3.0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the part
# ------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as part:
    # ---- Base: circular plate with 12 scalloped notches ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as base_sk:
        Circle(base_radius)
        for i in range(num_notches):
            angle = i * 360.0 / num_notches
            x = base_radius * math.cos(math.radians(angle))
            y = base_radius * math.sin(math.radians(angle))
            with Locations((x, y)):
                Circle(notch_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    extrude(amount=base_height)

    # ---- Upper section: hexagonal prism ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_height)) as top_sk:
        RegularPolygon(top_circumradius, 6)
    extrude(amount=top_height)

    # ---- Hexagonal socket cut into the top face of the upper section ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_height)) as socket_sk:
        RegularPolygon(socket_circumradius, 6)
    extrude(amount=top_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Chamfer the bottom edge of the base (12x C2.6) ----
    bottom_face = part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Export the finished solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part.part, "output.step")
